source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Verify the basic information on the inspection record.
3. Document your observations during the brake test.
4. Provide specific details of the failure.
5. Record the measured values.
6. Identify the potential cause of the failure.
7. Include a safety assessment of the failure.
8. Provide recommendations for repair.
9. Clearly present the failure information.
10. Obtain acknowledgment.

For more information, please refer to: [https://www.fleetio.com/blog/how-to-document-failed-brake-tests/](https://www.fleetio.com/blog/how-to-document-failed-brake-tests/)
